entries.desc: 运行 gap_analyze 时，10 个 high uncovered_requirement 都能映射到真实实现或明确的覆盖说明，high gap 数为 0。

evidence.note: After linking this worktree build globally, canonical user entrypoint koala gap_analyze prints 需求覆盖率 100% and 差距: 0 high / 32 medium.

entries.desc: 每个新增/调整的 @task 都落在对应实现模块，而不是集中到虚假 coverage 文件里。

evidence.command: git show HEAD -- packages/main/src/core/health.ts packages/main/src/core/anti-stall.ts packages/main/src/core/phase-flow.ts packages/main/src/core/workflow-policy.ts packages/main/src/handlers/story-review.ts packages/main/src/handlers/reviewer-list.ts packages/main/src/core/process-metrics.ts
evidence.note: Reviewed @task mappings are placed in the relevant implementation modules for health classification, anti-stall retry/fix/discard, phase graph health, workflow policy, reviewer policy, process metrics, and story review rather than in a fake coverage-only file.

entries.desc: 若某个 requirement 只是愿景或历史建议而无实现，gap_analyze 不能被注释硬盖过去。

evidence.note: Analyzer rules still scan truth requirements and produce gaps; the change merges source @task annotations with metadata-backed annotations and does not delete truth, lower severity, or skip uncovered requirements.

entries.desc: 不能通过降低 gap severity、删 truth、或关闭 analyzer 来让 high gap 消失。

evidence.note: Diff does not edit truth docs or lower severity thresholds; high gaps disappear because code annotations now cover requirements and gap smoke verifies analyzer output.

entries.desc: 运行 convergence_check 时，需求覆盖率输出为 100%，高优先级差距为 0。

evidence.note: Canonical user entrypoint koala convergence_check now reports 无高优先级差距 passed with detail 所有需求已覆盖 and 需求覆盖率 detail 100%. Only this active story remains unfinished.

entries.desc: 若 medium no_test gap 仍存在，输出能清楚说明它们不是本次 10 个 high uncovered_requirement。

evidence.note: gap_analyze now reports 差距: 0 high / 32 medium, making remaining medium no_test gaps explicit and separate from high uncovered requirement blockers.

entries.desc: coverage smoke 测试在没有工作区外部状态依赖时可重复运行。

evidence.note: Smoke locates project root from cwd/import path and repeatedly calls analyzeGap without external mutable state; local rerun passed.

entries.desc: 不能把 coverage 分母改小或跳过 truth 文件来得到 100%。

evidence.note: No truth files are modified and coverage denominator is still based on scanTruth; the analyzer change broadens code annotation inputs rather than shrinking requirements.

entries.desc: story_create payload 中 verificationIntent.type=cli_blackbox 会通过 schema parse，并归一为 cli。

evidence.note: Smoke parses story_create with type=cli_blackbox and asserts normalized output type is cli.

entries.desc: checklist_add payload 中 verificationIntent.type=browser_blackbox 会通过 schema parse，并归一为 browser。

evidence.note: Smoke parses checklist_add with type=browser_blackbox and asserts normalized output type is browser.

entries.desc: checklist_update payload 中 cli_blackbox/browser_blackbox 都会通过 schema parse，并保存为 cli/browser。

evidence.note: Smoke parses checklist_update with cli_blackbox and browser_blackbox and asserts they normalize to cli/browser.

entries.desc: 当前有效值 logic/cli/browser/manual/docs 行为保持不变。

evidence.note: Smoke loops through current valid values logic/cli/browser/manual/docs and asserts they remain unchanged after parsing.

entries.desc: 非法 type 仍然被拒绝，不能因为兼容 alias 而接受任意字符串。

evidence.note: Smoke uses a complete story_create payload with type=not_a_real_type and asserts schema parsing fails, proving alias compatibility does not accept arbitrary strings.
